kp_title: Identifying Elements of a Multiple Linear Regression
raw_html:
1.Identifying Elements of a Multiple Linear Regression?
x1 1 2 3 4 5
x2 10 25 32 42 15
y 0 −5 −2 2 7

The vector of coefficients of the plane y=β0+β1x1+β2x2 that best fits the data above can be found using multiple linear regression as

[β0β1β2]=(XTX)−1XTy,

where X is the corresponding design matrix and y is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix X in this context?

E
